meta.pm_convention: pmra = mu_alpha cos(dec), pmdec = mu_delta, mas/yr (catalogue arcsec/yr x 1000), positions at MJD 57170 (ra_pm, dec_pm). cos(dec) is not stated for the column in the CatWISE2020 paper or the IRSA column description; checked here against Gaia DR3 on 9 stars of the Epsilon Indi B field (Dec -56.8; G < 16, |pm| > 15 mas/yr, one CatWISE source within 2 arcsec): weighted slope CatWISE PMRA / Gaia pmra = 0.937 +- 0.102 (1.000 if cos(dec) is included, 1.826 if not; 8.7 sigma from the latter, 4.9 sigma with errors scaled by sqrt(chi2/dof)); fields near the equator agree too (RW Aur 1.02 +- 0.09, Barnard 1.21 +- 0.15).
meta.note: CatWISE2020 positions and motions carry an uncorrected systematic, typically 30 mas in position and 10 mas/yr in motion (IRSA catwise_colDescriptions; Marocco et al. 2021, Sec. III.3); small against the 3 arcsec grid.
meta.fast_note: CatWISE motions are not reliable for objects moving faster than about 1 arcsec/yr (Epsilon Indi B: catalogue 0.90/-0.68, Gaia 3.98/-2.47 arcsec/yr); such rows have pm_reliable false and are drawn at the catalogue position, not moved.
